stage: SFIT Part V Stage 5J -- programme step 1: independent pre-registered confirmation of Gamma(r)

estimator.reward: fixed-defect reward R_k(n) (Stage 5I eq. 2), averaged over k
estimator.cutoff: M = max(60, floor(25/(1-rho))), rho = 3r/(1+3r); burn-in 4M; T = max(4000, 20M)

run_plan.rule: exactly these runs, once each; no extra, duplicate, or re-seeded runs; every run is scored

tests.z_threshold_rationale: 19 z-tests (I1: 10, P1: 5, P3: 2, P4: 2); SEs from G = 32 groups (31 dof). Two-sided t_31 tail at 3.5 is 0.0014 per test, family-wise false-FAIL ~2.7% if every prediction is correct (|z| <= 3 with G = 16 would have been ~16%).
tests.sigma_obs: per point, sigma_obs = sqrt(SE_Gamma^2 + Delta^2), Delta = mean over groups of (Gamma_M - Gamma_2M); the truncation systematic always enters every Gamma test
tests.V1_truncation: per primary point, from the per-group differences Delta_g: the truncation is MATERIAL iff |mean Delta| > 3 SE(Delta) AND |mean Delta| > SE_Gamma. A material point is INVALID: excluded from P1-P3 and makes the outcome at best INCONCLUSIVE. V1 never produces FAIL by itself.
tests.I1_independence: plain-loop vs references: |z| <= z_threshold for Gamma and nu at each r, and chi2 p >= 0.01 for each quantity
tests.P1_intermediate: |z| <= z_threshold at each valid r, z = (obs - pred)/sqrt(sigma_obs^2 + sigma_stat^2 + sigma_model^2)
tests.P2_lower_bounds: LOWER-CONFIDENCE-BOUND test (the claim, not compatibility), at every valid intermediate point: (a) positivity  Gamma - 5 sigma_obs > 0;  (b) floor  Gamma - 3 sigma_obs >= 0.36
tests.P4_rice: |z| <= z_threshold for nu*sqrt(r) at r = 32, 64 (independent of V1: nu has no lag truncation)
tests.outcome: INVALID if any provenance check fails (hash, plan, duplicates, extra runs, missing runs, group-level recomputation). Else FAIL if any of I1, P1, P2, P3, P4 fails on valid points. Else INCONCLUSIVE if any point is V1-material (listing which tests could not be scored). Else PASS.
tests.scope: A PASS prospectively confirms the positive persistence curve at the listed r only. It is evidence for, not a proof of, Gamma(r) > 0 for all r.

interpretation_frozen.I1_fail: the two implementations disagree: code/definition error somewhere; no Gamma claim stands until resolved
interpretation_frozen.P2_fail: positivity or floor claim not confirmed at a tested r; Stage 4 premise must be re-examined
interpretation_frozen.P1_fail_only: interpolation model wrong near the minimum; positivity claim unaffected if P2 passes
interpretation_frozen.P3_fail_only: large-r functional form wrong; positivity unaffected
interpretation_frozen.P4_fail_only: Rice leading constant or its correction wrong; crossing-rate asymptotics to be revisited
interpretation_frozen.exploratory_event_index: NOT scored; reported only (sign of rho_e(l) at all lags; Gamma_event vs Gamma)
